analysis: Phosphofructokinase-1 is a key enzyme in glycolysis and gluconeogenesis, catalyzing an easily reversible reaction and subject to allosteric regulation. It directly transfers a phosphate group (Pi) to fructose-6-phosphate. While it does not directly produce ATP, it interacts with ATP in cells to regulate energy metabolism.
